verdict.rationale: Persona docs reference Workflows that automate decisions and 'decrease manual review time' and Reports/Inquiry data that could feed a review process, implying a manual review step exists, but there is no direct evidence of a review queue UI showing document images, extracted fields, and check results together, or of reviewer decisions writing back into the inquiry record. Missing for 10: explicit case-management/review queue documentation, evidence-bundling UI details, and confirmation that reviewer decisions update the verification record.
